scope: Closed solid arm anatomy and corrected arm skinning; compact shared curl atlas. Actual game character renderer in Chromium WebGL2; no native Mac performance measurement.

geometry.source: Owner Lagoon Heavy rig and derived surface; original GLBs, paint and clips unchanged
geometry.influences: Only same-side Arm, ForeArm and Hand; smooth elbow/wrist transitions exclude donor hips, legs, torso and head weights
geometry.runtime: One skinned body draw per figure; generated offline, no frame-time remeshing

paint.detail: Only curl tile retained at its previous pixel density. Skin uses selected vertex color and bounded neutral cavity shading; no painted arm skin.

browser.closePose: Two settled Heavy variants, bare hands and gold watch
browser.wardrobe: Tirol ranger, bald Heavy, Lagoon Hawaii/curls, Tirol ranger with olive trousers/native boots; one body submesh in all four
browser.skinProbe: All 12 selectable tones match rendered face, scalp, original forehead, arm, calf and socket RGB; lip shading remains relative to selected skin

validation.soak: 15 simulated minutes, 2 ticket round endings and 2 resets

remaining: Original native face paint and more detailed garment/weapon art
